title: Triangles: Angles and Sides
summary: The angle sum of a triangle, exterior angles, types of triangle, and the triangle inequality.

cbse.chapter: Ganita Prakash Ch 7: A Tale of Three Intersecting Lines
Earlier NCERT Ch 6: The Triangle and its Properties

objectives: I can use the angle sum of a triangle.
I can use the exterior angle property.
I can decide whether three lengths make a triangle.
misconceptions: Bigger triangles have bigger angle sums.
Any three lengths make a triangle.
A triangle can have two right angles.
